release_notes: Pigeon Poker 1.5.7 replaces the paid preflop range display architecture. The 174 scenario charts are now rendered directly from their authoritative 169-hand action-frequency matrices using native Tk Canvas. Runtime range lookup no longer loads the legacy bitmap catalogue or creates PhotoImage objects. Source-empty cells remain explicitly blank; the 1 BB charge is still checked atomically and only after the selected matrix has been fully validated.
